name: @arena/human-data-service
description: Arena human-data production studio reference service (Work Order C012; issue #118). The commission lifecycle (DRAFT -> SUBMITTED -> IN_PRODUCTION -> ASSEMBLING -> DELIVERED, with abandoned/failed states) as durable idempotent jobs on the reference fabric: commissions compile to ES1.0 EscalationRequests created and tracked through the injected C001 port (one seam, no new lifecycle), deliverables are collected from C009-ACCEPTED results through the injected deliverable-source port (the consent wall and the validation gate live in @arena/human-data and are fail-closed here too), and accepted, rights-gated sets assemble into versioned immutable dataset bundles over the A014 vocabulary. Fail-closed error normalization, envelope conventions per sibling services.
